entries.이 약은 삠, 타박상, 근육통, 관절통, 골(뼈)절통, 요(허리)통, 어: This medicine is used for pain relief and anti-inflammatory action in sprains, bruises, muscle pain, joint pain, bone fracture pain, low back pain, stiff shoulders, neuralgia, and rheumatic pain, and for itchy skin, insect bites, and chilblains (frostbite sores).
entries.이 약은 산 역류, 속쓰림, 위 내용물의 역류로 인한 소화불량(예를 들어: This medicine is used to improve acid reflux, heartburn, and indigestion caused by reflux of stomach contents (for example, after meals, during pregnancy, or when accompanied by reflux esophagitis).
entries.이 약은 성인의 병적인 체중감소, 뚜렷한 원인이 없는 쇠약, 식욕부진,: In adults, this medicine is used for pathological weight loss, weakness with no obvious cause, loss of appetite, asthenia, the recovery period after illness, states of suppressed metabolism resulting from long-term treatment with steroid preparations or from treatment of hyperthyroidism, and hypoproteinemia due to liver disease and kidney disease. In children, it is used for premature infants, young children, all symptoms caused by nutritional deficiency in children, growth retardation, low body weight, weight loss, malnutrition, loss of appetite, and periods of weakness after infection.
entries.이 약은 수술 및 외상 후, 유즙울체 시 염증성 부종의 완화에 사용합니다: This medicine is used to relieve inflammatory swelling after surgery and injury and in milk stasis.
entries.이 약은 습진, 피부염, 가려움, 두드러기, 땀띠, 벌레물린데에 사용합니: This medicine is used for eczema, dermatitis, itching, urticaria, heat rash, and insect bites.
entries.이 약은 습진, 피부염, 땀띠, 옻 등에 의한 피부염, 가려움, 벌레물림: This medicine is used for eczema, dermatitis, heat rash, dermatitis caused by lacquer and similar substances, itching, insect bites, urticaria, and chilblains (frostbite sores).
entries.이 약은 식욕감퇴(식욕부진), 위부팽만감, 소화불량, 과식, 체함, 구역: This medicine is used for loss of appetite, a feeling of fullness in the stomach, indigestion, overeating, upset stomach, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, loose stools, vomiting and diarrhea, stomach pain, abdominal pain, colic, excess stomach acid, and heartburn.
entries.이 약은 안구건조증이나 바람· 태양에 노출되어 생기는 화끈거리는 증상,: This medicine is used for temporary relief of the burning sensation, irritation, and discomfort caused by dry eye or exposure to wind and sun, and for prevention of irritation.
entries.이 약은 영양공급으로 보충될 수 없는 셀레늄 결핍 환자에서 셀레늄 보급에: This medicine is used to supply selenium in patients with selenium deficiency that cannot be corrected by diet.
This medicine is used to relieve the symptoms of nausea and vomiting.
entries.이 약은 위산과다, 속쓰림, 위부불쾌감, 위부팽만감, 체함, 구역, 구토: This medicine is used for excess stomach acid, heartburn, stomach discomfort, a feeling of fullness in the stomach, upset stomach, nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, sour belching, indigestion, loss of appetite, overeating, and a feeling of fullness in the stomach relieved by promoting digestion.
entries.이 약은 육체피로, 임신 · 수유기, 병중 · 병후(병을 앓는 동안이나: This medicine is used to supply vitamins A, B1, B2, B6, C, D, and E during physical fatigue, pregnancy and breastfeeding, periods of reduced physical strength during or after illness, the growth period, and old age, and to relieve dryness of the eyes and to prevent night blindness (poor vision at night), poor development of the bones and teeth, and rickets.
entries.이 약은 육체피로, 임신·수유기, 병중·병후(병을 앓는 동안이나 회복 후: This medicine is used to supply vitamins B2 and B6 during physical fatigue, pregnancy and breastfeeding, and periods of reduced physical strength during or after illness, to relieve angular cheilitis, cheilitis, stomatitis, glossitis, eczema and dermatitis, to supply zinc, and for muscle cramps caused by magnesium deficiency.
entries.이 약은 육체피로, 임신ㆍ수유기, 병중ㆍ병후(병을 앓는 동안이나 회복 후: This medicine is used to supply vitamins B2 and B6 during physical fatigue, pregnancy and breastfeeding, and periods of reduced physical strength during or after illness, and for angular cheilitis, cheilitis, stomatitis, glossitis, eczema, dermatitis, and muscle cramps caused by magnesium deficiency.
entries.이 약은 인후통, 기침, 가래, 춥고 떨리는 증상의 오한, 발열, 두통,: This medicine is used to relieve the various symptoms of a cold, such as sore throat, cough, phlegm, chills with shivering, fever, headache, joint pain, and muscle pain.
entries.이 약은 장내균총 이상(항생물질, 화학요법제 투여 등)에 의한 정장, 변: This medicine is used to regulate the bowels and to improve constipation, loose stools, abdominal bloating, and abnormal intestinal fermentation caused by disturbance of the intestinal flora (for example, by administration of antibiotics or chemotherapeutic agents).
entries.이 약은 정신적·신체적 기능무력 증상의 보조요법 및 회복기간(아미노산 결: This medicine is used as adjunctive therapy for symptoms of mental and physical asthenia and as adjunctive therapy during the recovery period (states of amino acid deficiency).
entries.이 약은 찢긴 상처, 화상, 창상의 살균소독, 궤양, 농양의 살균소독,: This medicine is used for disinfection of lacerations, burns and wounds, disinfection of ulcers and abscesses, disinfection of infected skin surfaces, disinfection of surgical sites, and disinfection of injection and catheter sites.
entries.이 약은 치은염(잇몸염), 치은출혈, 보철(의치)에 의한 염증의 통증 완: This medicine is used to relieve the pain of inflammation caused by gingivitis, bleeding gums, and dental prostheses (dentures).
This medicine is used for candidal vaginitis.
entries.이 약은 코감기, 알레르기성 비염 또는 부비동염에 의한 코막힘, 콧물,: This medicine is used to relieve nasal congestion, runny nose, sneezing, and a heavy feeling in the head caused by a head cold, allergic rhinitis, or sinusitis.
entries.이 약은 콧물, 코막힘, 재채기, 인후(목구멍)통, 기침, 가래, 오한(: This medicine is used to relieve the various symptoms of a cold, such as runny nose, nasal congestion, sneezing, sore throat, cough, phlegm, chills (feeling cold and shivering), fever, headache, joint pain, and muscle pain.
entries.이 약은 피부사상균, 효모, 곰팡이, 기타 진균에 의한 피부진균증(백선,: This medicine is used as an adjunct to creams or solutions for skin fungal infections caused by dermatophytes, yeasts, molds and other fungi (ringworm, cutaneous candidiasis, tinea versicolor), for skin diseases with superinfection by these fungi, and for erythrasma caused by Corynebacterium, and it is used in particular to prevent reinfection in infections such as athlete's foot.
entries.이 약은 항문생식기 부분(질, 외음부, 음경귀두 포함)에서 진단, 수술,: This medicine is used for disinfection of the anogenital area (including the vagina, external genitalia, and glans penis) before diagnosis, surgery, or catheter insertion, and for short-term disinfection of small wounds.
entries.이 약을 다른 점안제와 동시에 사용할 경우에는 다른 점안제를 사용하고 약: When using this medicine at the same time as other eye drops, instill this medicine about 10 minutes after using the other eye drops.
entries.이 약을 복용하기 전에 발진, 발적(충혈되어 붉어짐), 가려움 등을 일으: Before taking this medicine, people who have had rash, redness, or itching should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully.
entries.이 약을 복용하기 전에 항응고제를 투여하고 있는 환자는 의사 또는 약사와: Before taking this medicine, patients who are taking anticoagulants should consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.이 약을 복용하는 동안 인산염, 칼슘염, 경구용 테트라사이클린계 제제,: While taking this medicine, do not take phosphates, calcium salts, oral tetracycline preparations, antacids, or levodopa. Consult a doctor or pharmacist when taking it together with cardiac glycosides, oral contraceptives containing estrogen, antialdosterone agents, or triamterene. Avoid teas containing tannin, such as green tea and black tea, while taking this medicine and immediately before or after taking it.
entries.이 약을 복용하는 동안 진해거담제, 다른 감기약, 해열진통제, 진정제,: While taking this medicine, do not take antitussive expectorants, other cold remedies, antipyretic analgesics, sedatives, or oral medicines containing antihistamines. People who are taking MAO inhibitors used for the treatment of depression or Parkinson's disease, or who are within 2 weeks of stopping them, must not take this medicine. Before taking this medicine, people who are receiving diabetes medicines, gout medicines, arthritis medicines, anticoagulants, or steroids should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Patients receiving barbiturates, tricyclic antidepressants, or alcohol should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Do not drink alcohol while taking this medicine. This medicine contains saccharin.
entries.이 약을 복용하는 동안 테트라사이클린계 항생제는 복용하지 마십시오.이 약: Do not take tetracycline antibiotics while taking this medicine. Before taking this medicine, patients taking non-steroidal anti-inflammatory analgesics, ulcer treatments, digitalis preparations, chlorpromazine, lansoprazole, prednisolone, penicillins, quinolones, iron (Fe) salt preparations, or salicylates should consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.이 약을 사용하기 전에 눈의 통증이 심한 사람, 녹내장 환자, 안약에 의: Before using this medicine, people with severe eye pain, patients with glaucoma, and those who have experienced allergic symptoms caused by eye drops such as redness of the eyes, itching, swelling or rash should consult a doctor or pharmacist. If blurred vision does not improve with the use of this medicine, or if there is no improvement in symptoms after using it for several days, stop using this medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Use this medicine only for instillation into the eye. Do not let the tip of the container touch the eyelid or eyelashes. If it does, the solution may become contaminated or cloudy from eye mucus or mold. Also, do not use the medicine if it has become cloudy. To prevent contamination, do not share it with others. Do not use it as a wetting solution for soft contact lenses or while wearing soft contact lenses. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully. Excessive use may in fact cause redness of the eyes. If it accidentally stains clothing or other items, wash it off with water. Use an opened container as soon as possible, and do not use it after the expiry date.
entries.이 약을 사용하기 전에 이 약 또는 안약, 설파제에 과민증 환자, 눈의: Before using this medicine, patients with hypersensitivity to this medicine, to eye drops or to sulfa drugs, and patients with severe eye pain should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully. Do not use it continuously for a long period. Use this medicine for instillation into the eye only. Do not use it as a wetting solution for soft contact lenses or while wearing soft contact lenses. To prevent contamination, avoid sharing it with others as far as possible. In the case of a stye, be careful not to rub the eyelid or irritate the eye. Because the solution may become contaminated or cloudy from eye mucus or mold if the tip of the container touches the eyelid or eyelashes, be careful not to let it touch the eye directly. Also, do not use it if it has become cloudy.
entries.이 약을 사용하기 전에 중증 심부전, 신부전 환자는 의사 또는 약사와 상: Before using this medicine, patients with severe heart failure or renal failure should consult a doctor or pharmacist. This medicine must be used topically and must not be used as a parenteral injection. Do not use it if systemic absorption would occur. Do not use it if there are floating particles or if the container is damaged. When using it for irrigation, use a newly opened container and do not reuse any remaining solution.
entries.이 약의 구성성분 및 단백질계 약물에 과민증 환자는 이 약을 사용하지 마: Patients with hypersensitivity to the ingredients of this medicine or to protein-based medicines must not use this medicine. Before using this medicine, people with severe eye pain, those who have experienced allergic reactions caused by eye drops (redness of the eyes, itching, swelling, rash, reddening, etc.), and patients with glaucoma should consult a doctor or pharmacist. If symptoms worsen or continue for 3 days or more, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Use this medicine for instillation into the eye only. Wash your hands thoroughly before use. To remove any container fragments produced when opening it, discard the first 1 to 2 drops without instilling them when using it for the first time. After opening, use it only 1 time, and discard the remaining solution and the container after instillation. Be careful, because if the tip of the container touches the eyelid or eyelashes the solution may become contaminated or cloudy from eye mucus or mold, and do not use it if it has become cloudy. To prevent contamination, avoid sharing it with others as far as possible. This medicine may be used while wearing contact lenses. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully.
entries.이상반응이 나타나는 경우 복용을 즉각 중지하고 의사 또는 약사와 상의하십: If adverse reactions occur, stop taking this medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.일시적인 구역·구토, 복통, 설사, 체취, 발진, 두드러기, 안면부종 등: If temporary nausea and vomiting, abdominal pain, diarrhea, body odor, rash, urticaria, or facial swelling occur, stop taking this medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.자극이 나타나는 경우 사용을 즉각 중지하고 의사 또는 약사와 상의하십시오: If irritation occurs, stop using this medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.정제는 매일 대략 같은 시간에, 물과 함께, 포장에 표시된 순서대로 복용: The tablets must be taken at approximately the same time every day, with water, in the order shown on the package. Take the first tablet on the first day of menstruation, and continue to take 1 tablet every day thereafter even if bleeding occurs. When one package is finished, open a new package and continue taking the tablets. For details, refer to the approved product information.
entries.정해진 용법과 용량을 잘 지키십시오.장기간 계속 복용하지 마십시오.어린이: Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully. Do not take it continuously for a long period. When giving this medicine to children, administer it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian. If symptoms do not improve after taking 5 to 6 doses, stop taking this medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Drowsiness may occur while taking this medicine. Avoid driving a car or operating machinery.
entries.졸음, 두통, 혈관염, 광과민증, 현기증, 관절통, 인두염, 기침, 코피: If drowsiness, headache, vasculitis, photosensitivity, vertigo, joint pain, pharyngitis, cough, nosebleed, bronchospasm, hearing abnormalities, or visual abnormalities occur, stop taking this medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. If, occasionally, malaise, numbness, asthenia, restlessness, abnormal sensations, thirst, dryness of the lips, nausea, loss of appetite, stomach discomfort, indigestion, abdominal pain, stomach pain, abdominal discomfort, diarrhea, palpitations, chest pain, leukopenia, neutropenia, lymphocytosis, eosinophilia, swelling, itching, rash, or liver function disorder with elevations of AST, ALT, GTP, ALP, total bilirubin or LDH, jaundice, hepatitis, elevated BUN, glycosuria, blood in the urine, or rarely urticaria, angioneurotic edema, fixed drug eruption, or acute generalized exanthematous pustulosis occur, stop taking this medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.중증 또는 조절되지 않는 고혈압 환자는 이 약을 복용하지 마십시오.이 약: Patients with severe or uncontrolled high blood pressure must not take this medicine. Before taking this medicine, children under 2 years of age, people with an allergic constitution, those who have experienced allergic symptoms caused by medicines (for example, fever, rash, joint pain, itching, etc.), people with liver disorder, kidney disorder, thyroid disease, diabetes, a high fever or a weak constitution, pregnant women or women who may be pregnant, breastfeeding women, and people with heart disorder and high blood pressure, cough with excessive phlegm, or persistent or chronic cough such as asthma should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully. When giving this medicine to children, administer it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian. If there is no improvement in symptoms after taking several doses, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.진해(기침을 그치게 함)거담제(가래약), 다른 감기약, 해열진통제, 진정: Do not take this medicine together with antitussive (cough-stopping) expectorants (phlegm remedies), other cold remedies, antipyretic analgesics, sedatives, or oral medicines containing antihistamines (oral preparations for rhinitis (nasal inflammation), motion sickness remedies, allergy remedies). Consult a doctor or pharmacist when taking it together with diabetes medicines, gout medicines, arthritis medicines, anticoagulants, steroids, barbiturates, tricyclic antidepressants, alcohol, or flucloxacillin. Do not drink alcohol while taking this medicine.
entries.진해거담제, 다른 감기약, 해열진통제, 진정제, 항히스타민제를 함유하는: Do not take this medicine together with antitussive expectorants, other cold remedies, antipyretic analgesics, sedatives, or oral medicines containing antihistamines (oral preparations for rhinitis, motion sickness remedies, allergy remedies). Consult a doctor or pharmacist when taking it together with diabetes medicines, gout medicines, arthritis medicines, anticoagulants, steroids, barbiturates, tricyclic antidepressants, or alcohol. Do not drink alcohol while taking this medicine.
entries.출혈성뇌졸중, 구역·구토, 목마름(지속적이거나 심한), 변비, 식욕부진,: If hemorrhagic stroke, nausea and vomiting, thirst (persistent or severe), constipation, loss of appetite, rash and redness, itching, difficulty urinating (passing urine), headache, facial flushing, abnormal sensitivity to light, or rarely shock (anaphylaxis) occur, in which urticaria, swelling, and chest tightness appear immediately after taking the medicine together with pallor, cold hands and feet, cold sweats, and difficulty breathing, or if symptoms do not improve after taking 5 to 6 doses, stop taking this medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.클로르헥시딘, 설파디아진ㆍ은화합물, 알칼리, 수은을 함유한 제제, 효소성: Do not use this medicine together with chlorhexidine, sulfadiazine and silver compounds, alkalis, preparations containing mercury, enzyme-based wound treatments, hydrogen peroxide, or lithium therapy.
entries.테트라사이클린, 암피실린, 클로람페니콜, 세팔로리딘과 함께 사용 시 의사: Consult a doctor or pharmacist when using this medicine together with tetracycline, ampicillin, chloramphenicol, or cephaloridine.
entries.통증, 시야변화, 지속적인 충혈이나 자극감을 경험하는 경우 이 약의 사용: If you experience pain, changes in your field of vision, persistent redness, or irritation, stop using this medicine immediately and consult a doctor.
entries.투석요법을 받고 있는 환자는 이 약을 복용하지 마십시오.이 약을 복용하기: Patients receiving dialysis must not take this medicine. Before taking this medicine, patients with phosphate deficiency or kidney disorder and those who have had kidney disease should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Do not take it continuously for a long period.
entries.폐렴, 때때로 구강, 인두의 자극감, 구역, 드물게 구강(입안)점막미란(: If pneumonia, occasionally irritation of the mouth and throat or nausea, rarely erosion of the oral mucosa, sores in the mouth, contact dermatitis or discomfort, or very rarely angioedema occur, stop using this medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. If hypersensitivity symptoms or anaphylactoid symptoms occur, such as rash, sudden itching, swelling or heartburn together with pallor, cold hands and feet, cold sweats, and shortness of breath, stop using it immediately and see a doctor. Thyroid function may change reversibly while this medicine is being used.
entries.피부 건조, 드물게 가려움증, 홍반, 작열감 및 자극이 나타날 경우 복용: If dry skin or, rarely, itching, erythema, a burning sensation, or irritation occurs, stop using this medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.피부에 발진, 발적, 가려움, 정상 피부에 닿았을 경우 국소 자극 반응,: If rash, redness, or itching of the skin, or local irritation reactions, a tingling sensation, or dryness where it has touched normal skin occur, stop using this medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.피부의 세균성(전염성농가진, 모낭염) 및 진균성(칸다다증, 백선), 바이: If bacterial (impetigo contagiosa, folliculitis), fungal (candidiasis, ringworm) or viral skin infections, boils, skin irritation, stabbing pain, fever, a burning sensation, rash, redness, flushing, itching, dry skin, pustular dermatitis, allergic contact dermatitis, heat rash, sweat rash, worsening of wounds, bedsores, or pustulosis occur, stop using this medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. When it is used on the skin of the eyelids, blurred vision of unknown frequency may occur.
entries.필요 시 증상이 있는 눈에 1~2방울을 점안하고 점안 후 남은 액과 용기: When needed, instill 1 to 2 drops into the affected eye, and discard the remaining solution and the container after instillation. When using it at the same time as other eye drops, instill it with an interval of at least 15 minutes to avoid a dilution effect.
entries.필요시 증상이 있는 눈에 1~2방울씩 넣으십시오.용기의 개봉은 끝 부분을: When needed, instill 1 to 2 drops into the affected eye. To open the container, bend the tip fully back and forth and then pull it off.
entries.항생물질과 병용할 필요가 있는 경우에는 각각 흡입하거나 항생물질을 주사: When it is necessary to use this medicine together with an antibiotic, inhale them separately, or give the antibiotic by injection or orally.
entries.혈액학적 이상 반응 등이 나타나는 경우 복용을 즉각 중지하고 의사 또는: If hematological adverse reactions occur, stop taking this medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.환부의 가장자리까지 충분히 적용할 수 있는 적당량으로 하여 1일 5회씩,: Use an amount sufficient to cover the affected area up to its edges, 5 times a day for 5 days. Start treatment as soon as possible as soon as the first symptoms and signs appear.
entries.흥분(특히 어린이), 현저한 졸음, 불안, 어지러움 또는 불면증, 인후(: If excitement (especially in children), marked drowsiness, anxiety, dizziness or insomnia occur, if a sore throat continues for 2 days or more or is accompanied by headache, fever, rash, nausea or vomiting, if severe skin adverse reactions such as acute generalized exanthematous pustulosis (AGEP), fever, erythema and numerous small pustules occur, or if ischemic colitis (sudden abdominal pain, rectal bleeding, etc.) occurs, stop taking this medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. If symptoms of posterior reversible encephalopathy syndrome or reversible cerebral vasoconstriction syndrome (sudden severe headache, thunderclap headache, nausea, vomiting, confusion, seizures, visual disturbances, etc.) occur, stop taking this medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
